**Issue #164: neutrality source-scan guards for 4 remaining gate modules**

**What**: Added the same REQ-NEUTRALITY-2 source-scan regression test (asserts gate .mjs source contains no `.claude`/`SKILL.md` literal) to actor-check.test.mjs, brain-writes-reviewed.test.mjs, substrate.test.mjs, and run-check.test.mjs — mirroring the existing pattern in phase-order-check.test.mjs:376-381. Closes the coverage gap flagged as WARNING 1 in #144's sdd-verify (REQ-NEUTRALITY-2 explicitly names actor-check but only phase-order-check had the guard).
**Why**: User request to close a governance coverage gap on branch feat/issue-164-neutrality-tests. All 4 gate sources were already clean (0 literals) — these are regression guards against future harness-coupling, not RED→GREEN fixes.
**Where**: brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.test.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.test.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/substrate.test.mjs, brain/scripts/governance/run-check.test.mjs. Commit caede26 (not pushed).
**Learned**: actor-check.test.mjs and brain-writes-reviewed.test.mjs already imported `readFileSync`/`fileURLToPath` (no import changes needed); substrate.test.mjs and run-check.test.mjs needed those two imports added. Test suite went 772→776, all passing. Repo has a nested `brain/brain/scripts/...` path structure — cwd is /home/gandalf/IA/brain but actual source lives under brain/brain/.
